title: Evaluating Text Style Transfer: A Nine-Language Benchmark for Text Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text detoxification systems by comparing generated outputs against toxic inputs and neutral references using style transfer accuracy classifiers, content similarity embeddings, and LLMs-as-a-judge to measure the successful removal of toxic language.

Assessing the performance of evaluation metrics and detoxification systems across nine diverse languages (including Amharic, Arabic, Chinese, and Hindi) without language-specific fine-tuning to mitigate English-centric overfitting and language-specific evaluation bias.

Proposing XCOMET-based metrics and product-based probability scores to penalize evaluation systems that exhibit systematic bias toward human reference-like outputs while ignoring the semantic relationship with the original input.
